mapper.insert: INSERT INTO quant_protection_target (target_key,credential_id,position_id,position_cycle_key,position_side, protection_type,target_version,step_index,confirmed_step,updated_at) VALUES (#{key},#{credentialId},#{positionId},#{cycleKey},#{side}, #{type},0,0,0,UTC_TIMESTAMP()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_key=target_key
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_protection_target SET owner_token=#{owner},lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,30,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE target_key=#{key} AND (owner_token IS NULL OR lease_until<CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
UPDATE quant_protection_target SET lease_until=TIMESTAMPADD(SECOND,30,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_protection_target WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
SELECT * FROM quant_protection_target WHERE target_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_protection_target SET target_version=#{version},step_index=#{stepIndex},quantity=#{quantity}, trigger_price=#{triggerPrice},order_type=#{orderType}, pending_order_id=#{pendingId},previous_order_id=#{previousId},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE quant_protection_target SET current_order_id=#{currentId},pending_order_id=NULL,step_index=#{stepIndex}, confirmed_step=#{confirmedStep},quantity=#{quantity},trigger_price=#{triggerPrice}, order_type=#{orderType},updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE quant_protection_target SET pending_order_id=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE quant_protection_target SET previous_order_id=NULL,updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

UPDATE quant_protection_target SET current_order_id=CASE WHEN current_order_id=#{orderId} THEN NULL ELSE current_order_id END, previous_order_id=CASE WHEN previous_order_id=#{orderId} THEN NULL ELSE previous_order_id END, updated_at=UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner} AND lease_until>CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
UPDATE quant_protection_target SET owner_token=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE target_key=#{key} AND owner_token=#{owner}
